contract: Local bitmap adapter with source aspect-fit resizing off the main thread and30-entry FIFO disk cache. Original3photos recovered from archive whose3Swift files match every byte. Host provides one shared cache instance per private scope,id,sourceRevision,physical pixel size and decoded source Bitmap; revision must change when image bytes change. Cache identity includes revision and dimensions,fixing stale source/size reuse. SHA256names prevent key path traversal; atomic entry replacement,64MiB total/32MiB entry limits,calendar-day TTL and expiration check on every read. Scope-specific clear only removes owned hashed image entries; cancel pending loads before account clear. CRUD is synchronized per instance; do not create parallel instances for the same scope. JPEG100 for opaque output,PNG for alpha; source bitmap is never recycled. Cancelled context results cannot update UI or call failure callback; corrupt cache falls back to current original. Missing original without valid cache shows explicit failure instead of permanent spinner. Target pixel area capped16million; host owns source decode/privacy/permissions. Native font,scale/upscale interpolation,JPEG pixels and physical/iOS comparisons remain unverified.
